Bottle Information

Bottler: Signatory Vintage
Cask Type: first fill Oloroso sherry butts
Type: Single Malt
Volume: 70cl
Region: Speyside
Vintage: 2012
Age: 13 Year Old
ABV: 57.1%

Tasting Notes

Nose Rich raisins, dates, dark chocolate, and orange peel with hints of spice and polished oak. Palate Full-bodied and oily, revealing flavours of treacle, fruitcake, roasted nuts, and sweet sherry spice. Finish Long and warming, with lingering dried fruits, cocoa, and gentle oak tannins.

Benrinnes 13 Year Old 2012 is a bold and richly flavoured Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, bottled by Signatory Vintage as part of their acclaimed 100-Proof Edition (#78) series. Distilled in 2012 and matured in first fill Oloroso sherry butts, this powerful release was bottled in 2026 at 57.1% ABV (100 Proof), delivering an intense and full-bodied dram packed with classic sherry richness.

Benrinnes is renowned for its robust, meaty spirit, which pairs exceptionally well with first fill sherry casks. The result is a deeply satisfying whisky, brimming with layers of dark fruit, chocolate, and warming spice, balanced by the distillery’s signature weight and complexity. Bottled without chill-filtration or added colour, this expression offers a pure and authentic Speyside experience.

Why We Think You’ll Love It

  • 13 year old Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from Benrinnes

  • Matured in first fill Oloroso sherry butts

  • Distilled 2012, bottled 2026 at 57.1% ABV (100 Proof)

  • Part of Signatory Vintage’s 100-Proof Edition #78

  • Non chill-filtered and natural colour

  • A rich, sherry-forward whisky with bold, full-bodied character

The Benrinnes 13 Year Old 2012 Signatory 100-Proof Edition #78 is a powerful and indulgent Speyside single malt, showcasing the perfect marriage of robust distillery character and luxurious sherry cask maturation. Intense, complex, and deeply satisfying, it’s an excellent choice for lovers of full-flavoured, cask strength Scotch whisky.

The Distillery

Benrinnes
Benrinnes Distillery is a Speyside Scotch whisky gem situated at the foot of Ben Rinnes near Aberlour, drawing its name from the towering mountain that shapes the region’s cool microclimate. Established in the 19th century and now part of the Diageo portfolio, Benrinnes boasts a distinctive partial triple distillation process that imparts its single malts with a rich, meaty character balanced by subtle sweetness. While much of its production contributes to some of Scotland’s most notable blended whiskies, limited single malt releases—including those in Diageo’s Flora & Fauna range and various independent bottlings—showcase the distillery’s robust and complex flavor profile. Ideal for both Speyside whisky enthusiasts and collectors seeking rare expressions, Benrinnes exemplifies the craftsmanship, tradition, and terroir that define this storied region’s global reputation for fine Scotch whisky.
